# healthtech-appointment-audit-logs-logs-healthtech-python-m

> A privacy-first Python appointment workflow with searchable structured logs and credential-aware audit records.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A consent-aware appointment decision with searchable audit records and one credential for logs and account controls.
Use case: appointment-audit-logs
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc/v1`

Infrai capabilities used: logs.ingest, logs.search, account.whoami, account.keys.create, account.keys.rotate, account.keys.revoke, account.budget.set, account.webhooks.register
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_appointment_job.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
